text_block_list.text:
Back at the summer training camp, our daily training resumed.
Shinko Windy is giving it her all with plenty of spirit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaahhh! Trainer!
Another round of shuttle runs, please!
Windy-chan wants to run moreee!!
choice_data_list: You're fired up again today, huh!
You're fired up again today, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, of course it is, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"In our next race... I'll glue everyone's eyes
to me with pure skill, just you wait!"

Training is going well.
She is steadily gaining strength.
Someday... she should reach her "ambition."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... I didn't feel any resistance at all...
Am I... really getting stronger?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uryaaaahhhh! Not yet!
One more rep, let's goooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...! That voice is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What do you want, Biko?
Did you come here just to get pranked~? Hmm~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...I saw it! The Japan Dirt Derby!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...You were so cool.
You looked so majestic, so powerful...
it was a great run."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Gfufufufu!
Aheeeeeeeemmmmm!!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nothin' really~

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Well anyway, if Biko got scared, that makes me feel pretty good! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm spooked... or rather...
I have a lot... of mixed feelings about this...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey... can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai...
How can you push yourself so hard...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't win for so long...
and I was almost ready to give up...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yet Senpai is fighting not just to win or lose,
but against the public's judgment too...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I know she must be hurting way more than me,
yet she keeps a straight face...
getting faster and stronger all the time...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Senpai, how can you... push yourself so hard...?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You... were worried about something like that?
...That's just...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—First off, wipe your tears, nodano.
Your nose is running, it's messy, nodano.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wha! I'm n-n-not crying...
*hic*... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Listen, wouldn't you be pissed if things just ended like this?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pisses you off...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's with that puzzled look on your face?!
It's totally ticking me off!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If I give up now,
the stigma of being the 'dirty biter Umamusume'
will stay with me for life!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Listen to me! If you quit here,
you will de-fi-nite-ly never change!
Your chances will be zero!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What if it all... ends up being in vain?
What if no matter what I do, no matter how much I win,
it's still not enough...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's no point worrying about it before we even try!
We'll cross that bridge when we come to it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan will! I hate staying like this, so I'm gonna struggle and fight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Struggling on... huh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If I give up here too...
will my story just end with 'she couldn't win'?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You'll end up as a sore loser!
Windy-chan would totally hate that, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Besides... Windy-chan has a grand "ambition" of her own!
Yes... In her heart lies that grand "ambition"...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Windy-chan, Windy-chan is—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Talked about 100 years from now
as the top of the all-time strongest Umamusume rankings”...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become that kind of Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"—That is my grand ambition!
Well, whaddya think? Pretty shocking, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Is that...
why Windy-senpai never gets discouraged...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haha... Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I... I don't want to end things
just as I am right now, either...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Both of you... thanks a lot!
Man, I'm totally fired up now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, looks like you finally got your usual pep back, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I'm fine now!
I... don't wanna lose anymore!
Not even to Windy-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"For Windy-chan too? Huh?
And here I thought you were just moping around~!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Wanna have a match right away?
In some kind of training!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, minion!
Decide what we're going to compete in!
Make sure it's something quick enough to get back for dinner at the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's true...
choice_data_list: A guts contest to see who can do the most squats

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"If it's sumo, I wrestle Bono all the time,
so I'm really good at it!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Humph! In sumo, smaller folks are cleaaarly at a disadvantage!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Uryaaaaah!!
Uwoooooooh!!

A powerful roar echoed across the evening sky.
Shinko Windy wasn't satisfied with just one match,
and we ended up playing battle after battle until dinnertime...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep going until the sun goes down.
Just watch me, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
—Haa! Haa!
—Haa! Haa!
choice_data_list: Come on, you two, it's almost time...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: T-This isn't... settled yet--!!
Before the camp's cafeteria closed, I managed to persuade the two of them to head back...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It's your fault, Senpai,
for refusing... to surrender...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Windy-chan won't be satisfied
until she wins, she won't!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi... In the end,
Windy-chan won out...♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can get a good night's sleep now.
Good night to you~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Good grief...
She really hates to lose, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To be that particular not just in races,
but in training too...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that biting incident... was because of that too?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, biting is obviously bad, but...
her sheer obsession with winning is... incredible... I guess.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"That might be a kind of strength...
I never had..."

Having connected with each other's feelings,
what were they thinking now...?
And so, the night of the summer training camp passed by.
